requirement.description: {model_monica} proposed automating the KPI definition. Automated KPI tracking would let the model team validate forecast shifts during heatwaves in real time.
requirement.reading: Automated KPI tracking would let the model team validate forecast shifts during heatwaves in real time.

speaker.name: Model Monica
speaker.role: Specializes in designing, optimizing, and training machine learning models. Conducts data exploration and iterates on models to maximize predictive performance. Collaborates on model deployment, versioning, and performance monitoring.

output.objection: Automated KPI tracking is just the dashboard, not the engine that catches the heatwave drift before the morning order window opens. I need the model to flag those shifts in real time so we can adjust the allocation before the buyers lock the pallets.
output.correction: You logged this as a monitoring request, but I am talking about active model validation that triggers a retraining check, not just watching a number go red. The KPI definition is the output, not the input we need to automate.
